intro: After the Gordunni Scroll, Rok Orhan at Camp Mojache reads it as plans for a dark ceremony led by the Gordunni mage-lords. Rok Orhan wants you to take an orb from one of those mage-lords, to learn more about the ceremony and the Gordunni's magic.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: These seem to be plans for some sort of dark ceremony, friend. From what I can make out, this ritual is conducted by the Gordunni mage-lords.
Find one of these mage-lords, and from him, gather an orb.
The orb of a mage contains great power, and will help us discover more about this ceremony and the magic that the Gordunni wield.

clips.title: Progress
paras: We must discover more about why the Gordunni are here, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This orb will provide us with more information about the Gordunni... Which we will then use in planning their downfall, friend.
